note: _dulcis fuit glareis Cocyti_ – he hath been acceptable to the gravel of Cocytus (Douay Version), den Kiseln des Cocytus war er angenehm. Jerome refers to the death river Cocytus known from Greco-Roman mythology. – Friedrich Stummer: _Einführung in die lateinische Bibel_. Paderborn 1928 (viii, 290 pp.), p. 111; cf. the note in the Tusculum-Vulgata II, p. 1407.
